title: UM v1 pulled agent configuration rev-7 (frozen rev-5 config plus optional collect.monitor_export for Linux read-only traffic observation)
description: Candidate rev-7 additive overlay on the frozen rev-5 agent-config response. Every rev-5 field, requirement, constraint and fail-closed class rule is preserved; the only addition is an OPTIONAL boolean collect.monitor_export. It is not required, so stored rev-5 configs and new-center configs without it remain valid; absence means false/disabled. It is a source switch, not a credential: it carries no secret, path, URL or token. The center must include it only for a linux_vps node whose latest signed-snapshot agent.version satisfies the CFG-REV7 gate and whose operator/stored source flag and source-audit version are recorded; it must be omitted entirely for windows_terminal or unknown classes, never emitted for windows_terminal, and never inferred from the payload or a request. Agent-version gate CFG-REV7 (normative): the rev-7 Linux agent build advertises agent.version >= 1.1.0 (the current rev-5 agent is 1.0.0); the center tracks the latest agent.version from a successfully authenticated signed snapshot and MUST omit the collect.monitor_export key entirely (not emit false) while that version is unknown, missing or < 1.1.0, even if the stored source-enable flag is set; after a signed snapshot reports >= 1.1.0 the stored flag becomes effective at the next config pull, and a later older reported version (agent rollback) makes the center omit the key again. Comparison is the numeric major.minor.patch of the frozen agent.version grammar (eligible iff major > 1 or major == 1 and minor >= 1); this is a compatibility gate, not an authorization. Compatibility note: a rev-5 agent's JSON map decoder tolerates the extra map key, but the frozen rev-5 agent config validator requires exactly six collect keys and rejects a seventh, so a center MUST NOT send this key to an agent that is not known rev-7 capable; the rev-5 agent then fails closed and keeps its previous applied config.

monitor_export.description: Optional rev-7 source switch (Linux linux_vps only). Absence means false/disabled. When true, the agent may read the local fixed-path monitor-v2 traffic export and emit contract_revision=7 snapshot bodies. The source is authorized by the versioned UM-LT source-authorization audit, not by this switch; a center that has not recorded that audit, or any windows_terminal node, MUST NOT emit true. This is not a credential and does not enable singbox_api (which stays DISABLED/false).
